SWIFT BLUE-DROP  -  PACKAGING RELEASE
Vistex Chemicals Ltd  -  2026-10-09

CARTON   105 W x 48 D x 155 H mm, straight tuck end,
         euro hang tab 62 x 26 mm (7.8 mm headroom),
         5 scent vents per side panel.
         Blank 321 x 245 mm plus 3 mm bleed.
SHIPPER  319 x 196 x 160 mm internal, regular slotted
         container, holds 12 cartons (3 x 4), net 2.4 kg.
         Blank 1070 x 356 mm plus 3 mm bleed.
COLOUR   CMYK process, no spot colours. Total ink < 300%.
TYPE     Live text, embedded subsets. Outfit and Plus
         Jakarta Sans, both SIL OFL 1.1.
SAFE     Live copy 5 mm inside every cut and crease.

BEFORE PLATES
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - Replace the product photography. The blocks are ~160 dpi at
    pack size, lifted from the client card.
  - Barcode: removed on request. Most retailers require an EAN-13.
  - Regulatory copy is drafted, not legally reviewed.
  - Carton and case dimensions are design intent, not measured
    dies. Confirm with the converter before tooling.
  - QR resolves to vistexchemicals.co.ke/datasheet.html. Confirm
    the domain is live before the artwork is committed.
